title: Neuron Polysemanticity Spectrum Tool: A Quantitative Layer-by-Layer Polysemanticity Profile

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Knowing which layers are most polysemantic helps prioritize SAE deployment. This is useful for interpretability workflow optimization but the direct safety impact chain is indirect. It informs research strategy rather than producing a safety finding.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Activation extraction via TransformerLens is easy. However, computing polysemanticity scores requires designing a clustering approach for top-activating prompts and estimating concept activation distributions. The methodological design choices are non-trivial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Per-layer profile for all layers of GPT-2-Small plus before/after SAE comparison. The layer sweep is systematic but the clustering and polysemanticity scoring methodology needs to be designed. Moderate scope with some open-ended methodological work.
